The sole ordinary implementation association is local_syms/mods.rs. Its expanded-module query consumes unexpanded item identities; expansion dispatch resolves bang macros, parses their output, and recursively expands generated items. Attribute/derive handling reads attributes, resolves derives and consumes generated output; completeness paths inspect unresolved/failed/depth-limited expansion and derive facts. No checked-signature, trait-solving or body-checking operation is directly present in this file. This structural observation is not proof of transitive query dependencies or incremental reuse.
The complete associated test set is the one explicit TODO modules_expand_dependencies, with no assertions. Its stated verification matrix defers cold/warm boundary traces, invocation/selected-output invalidation, body-only and unrelated-signature non-invalidation, and equal-output backdating. These are meaningful outstanding verification prerequisites, requiring observable dependency/execution traces and controlled revisions; exclusion of checked signatures and trait solutions must also be established at that expansion boundary. The placeholder provides no behavioral evidence and the dependency guarantee remains unverified. Accepting this explicit test deferral does not upgrade implementation completeness or claim any reuse scenario passed.
Baseline: independently compared current implementation and entire historical test-source bytes to the supplied historical snapshot: both exact matches; complete claim and TODO test also match. Reassessed the historical rationale against current source and metadata, rather than adopting its verdict. No helper source outside initial fragments was used to assert transitive behavior.
